description: Fork of exp026 testing the 'saturated init + weight decay' hypothesis. Bit-LUT latents init in uniform[-0.5, 0.5] (mostly damped-gate regime, signs random ±) + bit_lut_weight_decay=1.0. Theory: STE gate damps large latents, so right-sign latents reach equilibrium between data gradient and WD; wrong-sign latents experience both data gradient AND WD pulling toward 0, drift through the gate-amplifying region near |w|≈0, and flip. Per-step decay = lr·wd ≈ 1e-3 at peak lr; over 8k steps cumulative decay factor ≈ 3e-4 → effectively zeroes any latent the data isn't actively maintaining.
